_meta.title: Mars Tactical EVA Vehicle Classes
_meta.note: Every numeric value carries explicit source and verified flags. Unverified values display a warning badge in the UI; every Manned rover value is flagged CONCEPT - not flight data.

marsGravityMps2.source: NASA Mars Fact Sheet (NSSDC, equatorial surface gravity 3.72076 m/s^2)

massEnergyCoeffWhPerKgKm.source: Assumption: regolith rolling resistance C_rr ~0.18 at g_Mars=3.72 m/s^2 and drivetrain efficiency ~0.65 yields ~1.03 J/(kg*m) = 0.28 Wh/(kg*km)

gradeWorkEfficiency.source: Assumption: electromechanical drive efficiency for uphill gravity work m*g*sin(slope)/eta

tiLooseThreshold.source: Existing web/scoring.js SCORING.effectiveSlopeLimit threshold (Mellon et al. 2000; fine unconsolidated dust/sand < 200 tiu)

sinkageMassRefKg.source: Assumption: reference rover mass (~MSL/Perseverance scale) for dimensionless mass sinkage multiplier

sinkageMassExponent.source: Assumption: sub-linear sinkage sensitivity exponent (totalMass / refMass)^0.35 on loose low-TI regolith

sinkageMaxPenalty.source: Assumption: maximum cell suitability penalty applied to low-TI sand/dust for heavier vehicles

roughnessRiskThresholdM.source: Assumption: local topographic relief/roughness onset above which higher speed increases dynamic tip/wheel impact risk

speedRiskMaxPenalty.source: Assumption: maximum suitability penalty at max class speed over high-roughness terrain

solarPanelEfficiency.source: Assumption: space-grade triple-junction GaInP/GaAs/Ge solar cell conversion efficiency under Martian spectrum + optical dust attenuation via STORM.dailySolar

solarSpecIrradiancePeakWm2.source: NASA Mars Fact Sheet (mean Mars solar irradiance at 1.524 AU = 586.2 W/m^2)

heaterBaseTempC.source: Assumption: actuator/avionics/cabin survival heating onset temperature; below 0 C heater demand rises linearly with cold (coupled to STORM.surfaceTempC)

nuclearHeaterWPerKgDegC.source: Assumption: electrical trace-heater demand growth per kg below 0 C (MMRTG waste heat offsets part of rover bus load; electrical peak draw rises in extreme cold)

baseMassKg.source: NASA Mars Pathfinder / JPL Sojourner Fact Sheet (~11.5 kg / 25 lbs wet rover mass; 10.6 kg dry)

speedKmh.source: NASA/JPL Pathfinder Sojourner documentation (~0.7-1.0 cm/s = 0.025-0.036 km/h top nominal ground speed)

extraLoadKg.source: Unverified micro-rover auxiliary payload/cargo slider range (flight Sojourner integrated APXS science instrument)

slopeLimitDeg.source: Prompt seed ~20 deg (unverified operational bound); NASA/JPL Pathfinder hazard-avoidance software avoided tilts >30 deg with 45 deg static tip-over design

mode.source: NASA Pathfinder Sojourner GaAs/Ge solar array (~13 W peak at Mars noon) + non-rechargeable primary backup battery

ratedPowerW.source: NASA Pathfinder Sojourner solar panel peak electrical output (~13 W)

solarAreaM2.source: Estimated effective horizontal GaAs/Ge panel area (~0.22 m^2 producing ~13 W at clear noon)

hotelPowerW.source: Assumption: avionics + thermal standby power draw during daytime drive window

baseMassKg.source: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance launch rover mass 1,025 kg; NASA MSL Curiosity rover mass 899 kg

speedKmh.source: NASA MSL/Perseverance maximum flat hard-ground speed ~4.2 cm/s (0.151 km/h)

extraLoadKg.source: Unverified extra science/sample cargo margin slider (0-100 kg; Perseverance carries ~59 kg science payload + caching system)

slopeLimitDeg.source: NASA/JPL MSL & MER operational practice (avoided tilts >30 deg in route planning; rocker-bogie stability rated to 45 deg; Perseverance cross-slope fault patch 24 deg)

mode.source: NASA/DOE Multi-Mission Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator (MMRTG, Pu-238)

ratedPowerW.source: NASA/DOE MMRTG beginning-of-mission electrical output ~110 W (recharges two Li-ion batteries for ~200 W driving peaks)

solarAreaM2.source: No solar array (MMRTG radioisotope power source is independent of optical depth tau)

hotelPowerW.source: Assumption: baseline flight computer + avionics + science bus electrical draw (~60 W before cold actuator/heater demand)

manned_rover.name: Manned rover
manned_rover.reference: Pressurized crewed rover (CONCEPT - not flight data)
manned_rover.reference_tr: Basınçlı insanlı gezgin (KONSEPT - uçuş verisi değil)

baseMassKg.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: prompt range ~3,000-8,000 kg (NASA SPR / LER / SEV ~3,000-4,000 kg lightweight chassis; Artemis/JAXA large rover concepts scale higher)

speedKmh.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: pressurized rover concept speed range 2-15 km/h (NASA LER/SEV nominal field testing ~5-10 km/h)

extraLoadKg.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: 0-1,000 kg crew + EVA suits + science/consumables allocation

slopeLimitDeg.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: existing app SCORING.HARD.slopeMax crewed rover default (15 deg conservative tilt limit)

mode.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: selectable conceptual power architecture (rechargeable battery / RTG-hybrid / deployable solar)

ratedPowerW.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: notional 8 kW average bus capacity for drive + ECLSS crew life support

batteryCapacityKwh.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: notional 60 kWh traction + ECLSS battery pack (not affected by tau, cold increases heating load)

nuclearRtgW.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: notional Kilopower/multi-RTG continuous electrical output (~2 kWe) + battery buffer

solarAreaM2.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: notional 24 m^2 deployable pressurized-rover solar array (~3.6 kW peak at clear noon)

hotelPowerW.source: CONCEPT - not flight data: cabin pressurization, ECLSS O2/CO2 scrubbing, avionics, and crew thermal control
